items.title: Jailer 2 Sets Record as Highest-Grossing Tamil Film, Surpassing Rs 710 Crore
items.sum: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has crossed Rs 710 crore in worldwide box office collections by its 11th day, making it the highest-grossing Tamil film ever. The movie surpassed previous industry records while still running in theaters, driven by strong viewer interest and successful Monday box office tests. Projections indicate that the film may soon cross the Rs 750 crore mark globally.
